digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / ticket creation and editing
propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) at create or edit time and the plan-review claim gate is enabled for the project, a warning must be emitted at save time stating the length, cap, and that plan review will refuse admission until shortened.

The save-time warning must reuse the exact same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) and gate probe (_plan_review_gate_applies()) that the plan-review admission guard uses, ensuring the warning's threshold matches the actual gate block.

The warning must be surfaced through all three integration channels: CLI (stderr), library (rebar logger, added return value on edit_ticket), and MCP (description_warning result field on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut).
The warning must never block, alter, or prevent the ticket write; it is computed after the CREATE/EDIT event is appended and degrades to None on any error.
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, or the ticket type is exempt from plan review.
